Bind build-source commit, reviewed-control commit, current clean HEAD, exact sorted build-to-review paths, and exact sorted review-to-current paths.

Recompute both Git diffs with --no-renames and require exact canonical set equality. Reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, absolute, traversal, glob, directory, malformed, non-ancestor, dirty, commit-drift, and hash-drift inputs.
Forbid native, dep, CMake, SQL, and worldserver-config paths unconditionally even if explicitly named. Never add broad tests/ or tools/ categories and never hard-code the current twelve paths.

Copy and hash-bind authority into the atomic bundle, bind its canonical projection in recurrence admission, reconstruct during admission verification, and require capture preflight to consume the admission-bound authority rather than a disconnected caller input.
Calls without authority retain existing exact-build and narrow-control behavior.

positive: Exact two-layer authority accepts the exact reviewed tools/tests lineage and reports both commits, counts, and hashes.
Atomic create/verify, admission create/verify, and capture preflight bind and reconstruct the same authority.
No-authority exact and legacy narrow-control cases remain unchanged.
negative: absolute, traversal, glob, directory, or renamed path
native, dep, CMake, SQL, or conf path even if named
capture authority not already verified and admission-bound
